Q9029.reason: Water is hypotonic, so absorption during washout can cause hemolysis and dilutional electrolyte imbalance such as hyponatremia.

Q9030.reason: A donee beneficiary's rights do not vest on signing; they vest on reliance, assent, or suit, so the parties could validly change the payee before the son learned of the contract.

Q9031.reason: Under UCC 2-210(3), a general ban on assigning the contract is read as barring only delegation, so the right to payment can still be assigned unless the clause specifically covers it.
